scientific_integrity: The underlying coupled Laplace equation and diagonal inverse-Gaussian case are from cited prior work. Only its derived high-tilt coefficient and rowwise classification are submitted as the finding.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite dimension and fixed nonsingular M-matrix with strictly positive immigration; no uniform small-coupling, growing-dimension or path-space result. Priority relative to inaccessible older full text remains provisional.
title: Fourth-root high-tilt fingerprints and exact inverse-Gaussian marginal criterion for coupled multitype clocks
